title: Pitchfork
summary: Two-handed simple melee weapon with Rush Attack.

fields.Weapon: Simple two-handed, 5-ft melee. 1d6 Piercing plus Strength. No Thrown property.
fields.Rush Attack: Action once per Short Rest with proficiency. Charge up to 30 ft and hit the first non-allied creature or object for 1d4 Piercing plus the attack ability modifier. Strength save against weapon-action DC or Off Balance for 2 turns. Off Balance gives attackers Advantage and gives the target Disadvantage on Strength and Dexterity checks until damage or Help clears it.
fields.Base value: 16 gp in BG3. Merchant prices vary.

changes: Added reviewed native BG3 gameplay and exact item and dependency citations.
